name: Madam President: She’s My Boss
source: As the school's self-proclaimed bounty hunter, you tend to cause more problems than you actually solve. But after standing up to the principal, you catch the eye of the beautiful student council president, who immediately recruits you as her hired muscle. With the help of her sweet secretary and, surprisingly, your worst enemy, it's time to embark on a mission to rectify the school's problems—starting with the principal himself! Can you save the campus from utter chaos while winning the hearts of these three gorgeous girls?
translation: 作为学校自称的赏金猎人，你制造的问题往往比实际解决的问题还要多。但在与校长对抗后，你引起了美丽的学生会主席的注意，她立即招募你作为她的雇佣兵。在她可爱的秘书以及你最大的敌人的帮助下，是时候开始执行纠正学校问题的任务了——从校长本人开始！你能拯救校园免遭彻底的混乱，同时赢得这三个美丽女孩的芳心吗？
